items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-07-31
items.q: I think I did hear the Perrini record.

ctx.x: she you know I remember particularly her teaching me one of the Eddie Cantor songs from one of his musicals yeah you know potatoes are cheaper and you know it's a time to fall in love yeah I remember I guess somehow I remember the cover of the of the sheet music had a if I remember it right a scantily dressed chorus girl mounted on a on a blazing sky rocket which impressed me at the time but there are also and she also had several old song type collections you know Stephen Foster things when you and I were young…

You still haven't talked about the thing originally entitled the Hiawatha, the Indian and a Mezzo. Do you know what that is? No. That's the original name of the The Lizard on the Rail. Oh really? Yeah, and Tony Perrini recorded it. I thought I would have played that for

it. No. I think I did hear the Perrini record. And Johnny used to play it, Johnny Wiggs. Yeah, well my mother used to, and I don't quite know where she picked it up from, but she used to sometimes sing a very brief business about there's a lizard on the rail, on the rail, on the rail, with his tail coupe.
